name: research-review
description: PR creation, review, claim audit, and finalization worktree and completed experiment outputs from a campaign dispatch, then runs the 22-step PR/review pipeline: prepare PR, run experiment lenses, stage bundle, compose PR, review, audit claims, resolve feedback, re-run if needed, finalize, and export. Terminates with sentinel emission of output paths.
summary: prepare > lenses > stage > [pr-compose > review? > audit? > resolve > re-run?] > finalize > export/complete

task.description: Research question or topic to investigate

base_branch.description: Branch to target for the research PR

output_mode.description: Where research outputs land. 'local' produces a self-contained bundle. 'pr' opens a GitHub PR alongside the bundle.

review_research_pr.description: When 'true', run the review-research-pr skill after the research PR is opened.

audit_claims.description: When 'true', run audit-claims after review_research_pr to verify citation integrity.

issue_url.description: Optional URL to an existing GitHub issue describing the research goal.

worktree_path.description: Path to the pre-created worktree (passed by campaign dispatch)

research_dir.description: Path to the research/ directory in the worktree

report_path.description: Path to the generated research report

experiment_plan.description: Path to the experiment plan file

experiment_results.description: Path to the experiment results file

kitchen_rules: NEVER use native Claude Code tools from the orchestrator: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash, Agent, WebFetch, WebSearch, NotebookEdit are ALL forbidden. All work is delegated through run_skill, run_cmd, run_python.
Do NOT auto-merge. The research PR is for human review only.
Route to on_failure when a step fails — do not investigate directly.

LENS ITERATION: run_experiment_lenses iterates over context.selected_lenses (comma-separated lens slugs, e.g. "fair-comparison,estimand-clarity") and context.lens_context_paths (comma-separated context file paths). For each lens slug, run /autoskillit:exp-lens-{slug} {matching_context_path} with the matching context file path. Run all selected lenses in parallel (multiple run_skill calls in a single assistant message). Accumulate each diagram_path value into context.all_diagram_paths using comma separation via capture_list. If a lens fails, continue with remaining lenses — partial diagrams are acceptable (compose_research_pr handles empty lists).

stage_bundle.note:
Idempotent file staging step. Copies phase-group, phase-plan, and exp-lens diagram artifacts from the worktree temp directory into research/{slug}/artifacts/. Creates images/ and scripts/ subdirectories. No compression, no rename, no commit. Safe to run multiple times — cp overwrites are idempotent. Runs after run_experiment_lenses to capture all exp-lens diagrams written to AUTOSKILLIT_TEMP/exp-lens-*/.
synthesis_algorithm: null — exp-lens readings forwarded to stage_bundle without aggregation. Dial (prepare_research_pr) -> Apply (run_experiment_lenses) -> Output (stage_bundle -> compose_research_pr).

route_pr_or_local.note: Branches on output_mode after bundle staging. local → bypass PR pipeline entirely, jump to finalize_bundle. pr (fall-through) → compose_research_pr to open PR and run the full review/archival flow. Uses predicate route because skip_when_false only accepts bare inputs.<name> with no expression evaluation.

guard_pr_url.note: Guard — skip review if pr_url is empty (graceful degradation from open_research_pr).

extract_pr_number.note: Extracts the PR number from the PR URL for use by annotate_pr_diff. Review publication is fail-closed when the authoritative PR identity cannot be captured.

annotate_pr_diff.note: Pre-computes annotated diff with [LNNN] markers and hunk ranges JSON for review-research-pr. A missing or unstable head fails closed before review publication.

review_research_pr.note: Optional research PR review step, gated by the review_research_pr ingredient. Verdict captured as review_verdict for deferred routing. All paths (skip, success, failure, context-limit) route to audit_claims so both gates complete before any resolution step begins. When on_context_limit or on_failure fires, the capture block does not execute and context.review_verdict remains absent; the recipe engine treats absent context variables as empty string in comparisons, so downstream route_review_resolve safely falls through to route_claims_resolve.

audit_claims.note: Optional citation-integrity gate, gated by the audit_claims ingredient. Runs after review_research_pr regardless of that step's verdict. All paths (skip, success, failure) route to route_review_resolve so both gates complete before resolution.

route_review_resolve.note: Routes to resolve_research_review only when the PR review found changes_requested. All other verdicts (approved, needs_human, empty/skipped) proceed directly to route_claims_resolve.

route_claims_resolve.note: Routes to resolve_claims_review only when the claims audit found changes_requested. All other verdicts (approved, needs_human, empty/skipped) proceed directly to merge_escalations. When audit_claims is skipped (inputs.audit_claims=false), context.audit_verdict is absent; the recipe engine treats absent variables as empty string, so the condition evaluates false and the fallback route to merge_escalations fires safely.

merge_escalations.note: Merged escalation consumer replacing check_escalations. Triggers a single re_run_experiment if either review resolution or claims resolution flagged a rerun. When only design_flaw escalations exist (or none), routes directly to finalize_bundle — design_flaw escalations are already posted as inline PR comments by the resolve skills. Both context.review_needs_rerun and context.claims_needs_rerun may be absent if their respective resolution steps were never reached (e.g., no changes_requested verdict on that gate); the recipe engine evaluates absent context variables as empty string, so absent == true is always false and routes safely fall through to finalize_bundle.

re_run_experiment.note: Targeted re-run of affected benchmarks after review resolution applied code fixes. Uses --adjust to read previous results and re-run only what changed. On failure, falls through to push as best-effort — the code fixes from resolve are already committed and should still be pushed.

re_generate_report.note: Re-generate the research report using the required experiment-results authority supplied to the recipe. The generated report path is captured for the remainder of the revalidation branch. Falls through to push on failure.

re_stage_bundle.note: Idempotent re-staging after report rewrite. Same body as stage_bundle — updates artifact directory with any newly written phase artifacts before re-testing. Falls through to re_push_research on failure (best-effort).

re_test.note: Post-revalidation test gate. Both pass and fail route to push — the re-validation results should be pushed regardless so the PR reflects the current state of the code and measurements.

finalize_bundle.note: Single compression point. Runs exactly once per recipe run. In pr mode: renames report.md → README.md, archives supporting artifacts, appends Archive Manifest, commits. In local mode: keeps report.md, excludes report.html/mermaid.min.js/images from the tar (they stay for local browsing), skips git commit. finalize_bundle_render always runs after this step regardless of mode.

finalize_bundle_render.note: HTML report rendering. Always runs after finalize_bundle on_success. Non-fatal: routes to route_archive_or_export on both outcomes, which branches on output_mode to either export_local_bundle (local) or review_pr_complete (pr).

route_archive_or_export.note: Branches after HTML bundle rendering. local → export_local_bundle (copy to {source_dir}/research-bundles/). pr (fall-through) → review_pr_complete to terminate the review pipeline.

export_local_bundle.note: Local mode terminal export. Copies the finalized research_dir (containing report.html, mermaid.min.js, images/, report.md, artifacts.tar.gz) to {source_dir}/research-bundles/{slug}/. Non-fatal — routes to review_local_complete on both outcomes.

review_pr_complete.message: Review phase complete (PR mode). Emit the L3 result sentinel JSON block now. The sentinel must include the following fields: success=true, pr_url=${{ context.pr_url }}, report_path_after_finalize=${{ context.report_path_after_finalize }}, worktree_path=${{ inputs.worktree_path }}, research_dir=${{ inputs.research_dir }}. Note: report_path_after_finalize is empty string when reached via the guard_pr_url fallback (pr_url absent) — finalize_bundle is bypassed in that path. Emit empty string for this field in that case. Example sentinel: {"success": true, "pr_url": "<url>", "report_path_after_finalize": "<path>", "worktree_path": "<path>", "research_dir": "<path>"}

review_local_complete.message: Review phase complete (local mode). Local bundle exported successfully. Emit the L3 result sentinel JSON block now. The sentinel must include: success=true, local_bundle_path=${{ context.local_bundle_path }}, pr_url="" (empty string — no PR in local mode), report_path_after_finalize="" (empty string — no finalization in local mode). Example sentinel: {"success": true, "local_bundle_path": "<path>", "pr_url": "", "report_path_after_finalize": ""}

escalate_stop.message: Review pipeline failed — human intervention needed. Check the latest step output for details. Emit the L3 result sentinel JSON block now with success=false. Example sentinel: {"success": false, "reason": "review pipeline failed"}
